description: This file defines the 'Video' class, which manages video recordings of web page interactions within the Playwright testing framework. It provides methods to access the video path, save the video to a specified location, and delete the video artifact.

classes.name: Video
classes.description: A class representing a video recording of a webpage, providing methods to interact with the video artifact such as retrieving its path, saving, and deleting.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the Video class, setting up necessary properties and asynchronous artifact retrieval.

methods.name: _artifactReady
methods.description: Resolves the promise indicating the artifact is ready for use.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Returns the absolute path of the video file, throws an error if connected remotely or if no video frames were produced.

methods.name: saveAs
methods.description: Saves the video artifact to a specified file system path.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the video artifact if it exists.
